title: Batched release signing, compact provenance index and rollback checkpoint snapshots
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context: Private deployments that rely on airgapped installers and TUF-style release manifests are increasingly constrained by provenance index size and KMS signing rate limits during large coordinated rollouts. This PR introduces three coordinated changes: (1) batched signing with a pooled offline signer to reduce per-artifact KMS operations during release windows, (2) a compact, chunked provenance index format that permits streamable verification and reduced disk footprint on airgapped hosts, and (3) lightweight rollback checkpoint snapshots that enable fast, atomic rollbacks without replaying the full artifact graph.

What changed (high level):
- CI pipeline: new pipeline job ci/pipelines/offline-release.yaml that orchestrates batched signing, uploads chunked index pieces, and emits checkpoint metadata. The job supports both online (cosign/KMS) and offline (HSM/dedicated signer host) modes.
- Indexer: tools/indexer/compact_indexer.py implements chunking heuristics (by artifact-batch and time-window), gzip + snappy backends, and generation of per-chunk provenance attestations.
- Signer: ci/release/batched_sign_and_index.go adds a signer pooling mode that groups artifacts into signing batches (configurable), minimizes KMS API calls, and emits a batch manifest with cosign signatures and key identifiers.
- Rollbacks: scripts/mk-checkpoint.sh and release/checkpoints/README.md document creation and validation of rollback checkpoints. Checkpoints are small JSON manifests that reference chunk IDs and signature digests to allow atomic switch-over at deploy time.
- Helm & Terraform: helm/charts/private-installer/templates/release-index.yaml updated to reference chunked indexes and support staged preflight checks; terraform/modules/release-manifests/main.tf exposes variables for checkpoint retention and chunk lookup.
- Docs & tests: docs/private-installer/compact-index.md describes offline validation steps; added unit/integration tests to ci/integration/ that validate integrity across signing modes.

Testing & validation:
- Unit tests: index chunking, signature bundling, and checkpoint generation covered with parameterized tests.
- Integration: end-to-end CI job runs in sandbox using a local signer image + ephemeral KMS emulator; artifacts uploaded to staging registry and validated with the modified installer.
- Performance: compact indexing reduced on-disk index size by ~58% on our benchmark dataset (50k artifacts); batched signing reduced KMS request counts by ~83% for a typical release window (measured in ci/perf/signed_batch_bench).

Migration and rollout notes:
- Backwards compatibility: the installer supports both legacy index.json and the new chunked index via a compatibility shim; new installs will prefer chunked indexes when available.
- Rollout plan: gated behind a feature flag (release_index_chunking) for three weeks on staging, then progressively enabled for production releases. The CI pipeline preserves both index types for 30 days and creates checkpoints after each major release to support rollback.
- On-prem operator action: for airgapped upgrades, operators must copy chunk files and the corresponding checkpoint manifest to the airgap media; docs include a checklist.

Risks & mitigations:
- Risk: signer pooling increases blast radius if a batch is compromised. Mitigation: each artifact still has per-artifact signature entries in the batch manifest; key rotation and per-batch attestation UIDs are enforced.
- Risk: index chunk loss could prevent partial verification. Mitigation: each chunk has redundancy metadata and the installer will fall back to full index verification if chunk integrity fails.

Follow-ups: add delta-only chunk generation (ENG-2309) and long-term retention pruning policy (ENG-2310).

release_notes:
- Add support for chunked/compact provenance indexes for private installer releases to reduce on-disk footprint and enable streamable verification.
- Introduce batched release signing mode to reduce KMS call volume during large rollouts.
- Add lightweight rollback checkpoints for fast, atomic rollback capability.
Operators: follow docs/private-installer/compact-index.md for airgap checklist.
